Pope Francis leads mass for millions in Buenos Aires

Pope Francis led a mass in Buenos Aires, Argentina, drawing an estimated 2.5 million people. During the event, he urged young Argentines to resist social media pressure. The Pope also renewed a warning regarding austerity measures implemented by President Javier Milei.
